fields.imageBrief: Two widescreen monitors side by side on a raised supervisor desk in a dim crisis call center. The left monitor shows a large dashboard of colored queue tiles in amber and green. The right monitor shows a dense tabular report with red and amber status cells. Rows of counselors with headsets are softly blurred in the background. No legible text.

instructorNote: After you hand this over, read Marcus's line aloud: "The board's two intervals behind now. It's still on 13:15. The text queue has been over threshold since 13:20. That's 50 minutes on the clock. We've got ten minutes left. Then we break the 60-minute line." Look for three things. The surge commander should run the floor from the platform report and tell the Technology Manager about the board lag (Ops Plan 3). The surge commander should log a backup request for texts and chats with the state backup center before 14:20, recording the party, contact type and start time (Surge Plan 4 and the section on requesting backup). The Workforce Coordinator should report only agents logged in, agents on contacts and confirmed arrivals, not the 38 'available' names in the workforce tool.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: A monitor photographed at an angle, slight moiré and reflections. Two widescreen monitors side by side on a raised supervisor desk in a dim crisis call center during a busy afternoon, photographed at a slight angle from the supervisor's chair. The left monitor glows with a grid of large rounded dashboard tiles in amber and soft green, its figures unreadable from this distance. The right monitor shows a dense tabular report, rows of small cells highlighted in red and amber, too fine to read. A coffee mug, a desk phone and a headset rest on the desk in the foreground. Behind the screens, rows of crisis counselors wearing headsets lean toward their workstations and are softly blurred. Cool overhead lighting is mixed with screen glow, shallow depth of field, and the mood is tense and focused.
